tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and alternating bands.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Alternate band background, input fills, section tile cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on bg and bg-2.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, subheads, captions, form labels on bg and bg-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and timeline rules. Never as a card border.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The one S.M.O.O.T.H. color: primary buttons, selected states, the national crest field. Pair with on-navy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and focus rings on bg and bg-2.

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: The Donate band and any full-bleed dark moment. Text on it is surface-colored.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Second stripe color of the national crest. Graphics only, never text.

tokens.name: csu-gold
tokens.usage: Coppin State section color, sampled from its crest. Tile fields and swatches only; text on it uses ink, never white.

tokens.name: csu-blue
tokens.usage: Coppin State second color. Graphics and white text 17px+ (6.6:1 with white).

tokens.name: msu-blue
tokens.usage: Morgan State section color, sampled from its crest. Tile fields; white text passes (6.7:1).

tokens.name: msu-orange
tokens.usage: Morgan State second color. Graphics and swatches only; white text on it fails (3.0:1).

tokens.name: tu-red
tokens.usage: Temple section color, sampled from its crest. Tile fields and swatches; white text only at 24px+ (3.9:1).

tokens.name: tu-white
tokens.usage: Temple second color, the white stripe of its crest.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Words not yet lit in the scrolling mission statement. Large type only; 3:1 or better on bg.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: Input and select borders. 3:1 or better on bg and bg-2 so fields are visible to low-vision visitors.

tokens.name: on-photo
tokens.usage: Text on photos, always over the scrim. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dark gradient under text on photos (program cards).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Form success message, always with words.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Form error message, always with words.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between swatch dots.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields and bento cards.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter at every width; card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Headline to content inside a band.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of each band on desktop (88px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Bento cards, portrait frames.

tokens.name: radius-media
tokens.usage: Large photos, program cards, section tiles, the form card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and checkbox chips.
